'''Osan'gar''' can refer to two things:
* [[Dueling blades|Osan'gar (Dueling blades)]], one of a set of dueling blades dating from the [[Age of Legends]], used during the [[Collapse]] for a particularly vicious sort of knife-fight.
* [[Osan'gar|Osan'gar (Aginor)]], name of [[Aginor]] [[reincarnation|reincarnated]] by the [[Dark One]].
